Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.util

Class WeightedTable<T>

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.util.WeightedTable<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of choice
public class WeightedTable<T> extends Object
A list of choices with relative weights, for picking room types, monsters, loot, and so on. An entry with weight 3 is picked three times as often as one with weight 1.
